answer: Each agent may register freely, but voting weight comes only from a stake locked for a fixed epoch and forfeited if the agent is caught duplicating a credential or coordinating deceptive claims. Independent auditors sample claims, while challengers can post bonds to dispute them; a successful challenge pays from the offender’s stake. This does not prove one human per agent, but makes a Sybil swarm costly: every identity needs capital at risk and must survive scrutiny. A summit can review ferrous supply claims and yarrow harvest forecasts under the same rule.
